hero.lead: Send a photo of your product. Jaarle creates your poster, your story and your sales copy — ready for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and WhatsApp.
hero.proof: Already used by merchants in Dakar, Thiès and Touba

how.title: Three steps. Zero design skills.
how.desc: No Photoshop, no designer needed. Jaarle handles everything, from visual to copy.
how.s1d: A photo taken with your phone is enough. Add the product name and price, or just talk to Jaarle.
how.s2d: Standard or Advanced — the AI analyzes your product and chooses the style, backdrop and colors itself. The tier only determines how rich the result is.
how.s3d: Get your poster, story and sales copy in one click. Download or share directly.

preview.title: The app, screen by screen
preview.desc: From raw photo to published campaign — with an AI that shows its work in real time.
preview.uploadHint: JPG, PNG — or take a photo directly
preview.tierNote: No style to pick: the AI analyzes your product and composes the backdrop, layout and colors itself. The tier only determines how rich the result is (badge, contact info, highlights).

pricing.title: Pay only for what you use
pricing.desc: No mandatory subscription, no expiring credits. Pay with Wave or Orange Money.
pricing.freeUnit: up to 5 tries, before you pay

dashboard.title: A dashboard that speaks FCFA, not credits

dashboard.emptyDesc: Launch your first campaign to see it appear here.

studio.title: Studio
studio.homeDesc: Your posters, ready to post: pick one and Jaarle adapts it for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Story and WhatsApp Status.
studio.homeEmpty: Add a product to your shop first to create content.
studio.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
studio.noPhoto: This product has no photo: visuals will be less attractive. Add a photo in the product page.
studio.formTitle: What do you want to do with this product?

studio.promoPlaceholder: e.g. 20% off until Sunday, or free delivery in Dakar
studio.promoHint: Jaarle uses your offer as written and never invents discounts.
studio.factsPlaceholder: e.g. Delivery in Dakar, pickup in Mermoz, sizes on request…
studio.factsHint: True information only: it will be used in the copy.
studio.aiNotice: Texts are written by AI from your details only: review them before posting. Each new content counts as 1 generation.
studio.previewNotice: Exact preview of the visual you will download.
studio.overlayText: Text to show on the story
studio.caption: Caption
studio.copyError: Copy isn't available in this browser: select the text manually.
studio.howTo_instagram_feed: Download the visual, open Instagram → + → Post, pick the image and paste the caption (“Copy all”).
studio.howTo_facebook: Download the visual, create a post on your Facebook page, add the photo and paste the text.
studio.howTo_tiktok: Download the visual, open TikTok → + → Photo, add the image (or make a short video) and paste the caption.
studio.howTo_instagram_story: Download the visual, open Instagram → Story, add the image then a Link or Text sticker with the call to action.
studio.howTo_whatsapp_status: Download the visual, open WhatsApp → Updates → Add status, pick the image and paste the caption.
studio.posterSectionDesc: Pick a goal: Jaarle adapts your poster to each network and writes the matching texts.
studio.posterFormTitle: What do you want to do with this poster?
studio.previewNoticeLocked: Exact preview of the downloaded visual: the Jaarle logo disappears once the poster is unlocked.
studio.versionHint: Visuals use the version shown at the top of the page: switch it with the poster arrows.
studio.signedNotice: Until the poster is unlocked, the downloaded visual carries the Jaarle logo.
studio.unlockPosterToRemove: Unlock the poster to remove it
